note: Every number below is a PLAUSIBLE default chosen for design feasibility, not calibrated against field data. Owner-adjustable; changing any value changes policyVersion and therefore datasetVersion. Phase 4.39 adds flag bits 13 and 14 (scheduled-service evidence) only; every earlier value is unchanged.
asOfRule: The resolver takes asOf as an explicit input (dataset build date). It never reads the wall clock, so a rebuild is byte-identical.

P-A.label: default: contest only when weak dissent comes from >= 2 DISTINCT evidence kinds; a single weak dissent is flagged

P-B.label: conservative for comfort: any applicable weak dissent contests

staleness._doc: days since observedAt (start of period). fresh <= freshDays < aging <= agingDays < stale. observedAt null => unknown_age (never invented). Works/maintenance feeds are NOT here: they are review triggers only.

levels._doc: decisive: human_verified|field_verified measured/reported evidence with a known date, exact/partial coverage, not stale. supporting: tagged; derived from a source authoritative for that attribute; unverified measured that is fresh/aging. weak: everything else that may vote (unverified reports, non-authoritative derived, coarse coverage, stale non-tagged). trigger: adjacent coverage (opens a review task, never votes). informational: wrong mode, non-discriminating source, rejected, inferred (v0).

bands._doc: Ordinal rule prior, not a probability. unverified evidence never exceeds medium; contested and weak-dissent cap at low.
bands.medium: decisive aging; OR supporting with a known fresh/aging date; OR >= 2 independent evidences of different sources agree and at least one is supporting
bands.low: supporting with unknown or stale age; weak-only agreement; contested; weak dissent present

adapter._doc: Maps a resolved attribute view to the EXISTING scorer categories. Policy, not data: versioned separately from the ledger. Only the car/motorcycle overlay is compiled in v0.
adapter.materialKnown: same mapping as scripts/osm/normalize.mjs classifySurface (no override emitted when the base category already equals it)

contestedStoneVsSmooth.why: weak evidence is never called confirmed; 0.65 is the existing paving_stones weight

unknown.flag: SURFACE_UNKNOWN_BY_EVIDENCE only when a source was ignored; never smooth

adapter.rails: flag bits only, never a surface category; warning and weighting are a separate product decision per mode
